rollback: Not yet certified. Restoring earlier application artifacts does not undo state changes or restore sandbox files.
restartPolicy: Application-only deploys normally hot-adopt. Runtime changes require a node restart; quiesce sessions and verify workspace checkpoints and an off-machine storage backup first.
validation: Automated checks plus isolated deployment/UI/API smoke. Model turns, terminal/preview transport, live hot-deploy and restart recovery require the manual release checklist.
